books.title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
books.author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest
books.subject: Design & Analysis of Algorithms
books.description: Standard textbook for Design and Analysis of Algorithms. Contains highlighted notes on Dynamic Programming, Greedy Algorithms, and Graph Theory (BFS/DFS). Clean pages, no torn edges.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Used for CIE 1 and Semester Exam. Passing it forward for juniors tackling DAA!

books.title: Database System Concepts
books.author: Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, S. Sudarshan
books.subject: Database Management Systems
books.description: Comprehensive guide covering Relational Calculus, SQL transactions, ACID properties, B+ Trees indexing, and normalization forms (1NF through BCNF). Highly recommended for Lab 5.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Exam completed. Passing forward to the next peer in chain!

books.title: Operating System Concepts (Dinosaur Book)
books.author: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter B. Galvin, Greg Gagne
books.subject: Operating Systems & System Software
books.description: Covers process scheduling, semaphore synchronization, banker algorithm for deadlock avoidance, virtual memory paging, and Linux kernel internals.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Handover arranged at Central Library 2nd Floor for 6th Sem.

books.title: Computer Networks - A Systems Approach
books.author: Larry L. Peterson, Bruce S. Davie
books.subject: Computer Networks & Protocols
books.description: Complete syllabus guide for OSI Model, TCP/IP handshake, sliding window protocols, CIDR routing, and DNS architecture.

books.title: Higher Engineering Mathematics
books.author: Dr. B.S. Grewal
books.subject: Engineering Mathematics III & IV
books.description: The definitive textbook for engineering mathematics: Laplace transforms, Fourier series, partial differential equations, and complex analysis. Solved question bank included.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Helped score an S grade in 3rd sem math. Great worked examples for exam prep.

books.title: Introduction to Automata Theory, Languages, and Computation
books.author: John E. Hopcroft, Rajeev Motwani, Jeffrey D. Ullman
books.subject: Theory of Computation & Automata
books.description: Classic text on Deterministic & Non-deterministic Finite Automata (DFA/NFA), Regular Expressions, Context-Free Grammars, Pushdown Automata, and Turing Machines.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Annotated solutions for Pumping Lemma proofs and CFG Chomsky Normal Form.

books.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
books.author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
books.subject: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
books.description: The worldwide benchmark for AI: informed search (A* search, minimax), constraint satisfaction problems, probabilistic reasoning, and deep reinforcement learning.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Brand new edition used during CIE 2. Clean spine with zero markings.

books.title: Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach
books.author: Roger S. Pressman, Bruce R. Maxim
books.subject: Software Engineering & Agile Methodologies
books.description: Covers SDLC models, Scrum/Agile sprints, UML architectural design, software testing metrics, and CI/CD pipelines.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Contains helpful diagrams for SRS documentation and use-case modeling.

books.title: Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools (Dragon Book)
books.author: Alfred V. Aho, Monica S. Lam, Ravi Sethi, Jeffrey D. Ullman
books.subject: Compiler Design & Lexical Analysis
books.description: The legendary Dragon Book covering Lex/Yacc, LL(1) and LR(1) parsing tables, intermediate code representation, and loop optimization.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Essential guide for the 6th semester Compiler Lab project.

books.title: Cryptography and Network Security: Principles and Practice
books.author: William Stallings
books.subject: Cryptography & Cyber Security
books.description: Standard textbook for AES, RSA, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, SHA-3 hashing, digital signatures, and TLS protocols.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Flawless copy with solved numerical problems on modular arithmetic and RSA.

books.title: Data Structures and Algorithms in Java
books.author: Robert Lafore
books.subject: Data Structures & Problem Solving
books.description: Intuitive visual guide for arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, binary search trees, red-black trees, and hash tables with Java implementations.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Fantastic beginner-friendly book that makes pointer concepts crystal clear.

books.title: Computer Organization and Architecture: Designing for Performance
books.author: William Stallings
books.subject: Computer Architecture & Microprocessors
books.description: Detailed coverage of pipelining hazards, cache memory mapping (direct, associative), RAID architecture, and RISC-V vs CISC instruction sets.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Highlighters on Cache hit/miss ratio calculation and Amdahl law questions.

books.title: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications
books.author: Kenneth H. Rosen
books.subject: Discrete Mathematical Structures & Graph Theory
books.description: Comprehensive resource on propositional logic, set theory, recurrence relations, Pigeonhole principle, and Euler/Hamiltonian graphs.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Pristine copy with all chapter summary sheets intact. Must-read for CSE 3rd sem.

books.title: Digital Signal Processing: Principles, Algorithms & Applications
books.author: John G. Proakis, Dimitris G. Manolakis
books.subject: Digital Signal Processing & Filter Design
books.description: Comprehensive coverage of discrete-time signals, Z-transforms, Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT), FFT algorithms, and IIR/FIR filter realization.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Complete worked solutions for Butterworth and Chebyshev filter design.

books.title: CMOS VLSI Design: A Circuits and Systems Perspective
books.author: Neil H.E. Weste, David Money Harris
books.subject: VLSI Design & Semiconductor Electronics
books.description: Covers MOSFET fabrication, CMOS inverter DC characteristics, dynamic logic circuits, memory arrays, and layout DRC rules.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Has notes on Euler path and stick diagram drawing conventions.

books.title: Cloud Computing: Concepts, Technology & Architecture
books.author: Thomas Erl, Ricardo Puttini, Zaigham Mahmood
books.subject: Cloud Computing & Distributed Systems
books.description: Covers IaaS/PaaS/SaaS delivery models, hypervisor virtualization, elastic scalability, microservices orchestration, and SLA metrics.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Very clean with sticky tags on AWS and containerization chapters.

books.title: Engineering Physics: Modern Physics & Optics
books.author: Dr. S.L. Gupta, Sanjeev Gupta
books.subject: Engineering Physics & Quantum Mechanics
books.description: First-year core textbook: Quantum mechanics, de Broglie hypothesis, Lasers and Fiber Optics, Superconductivity, and Nanomaterials.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Passed down from senior Rohan Deshmukh. Helped score top marks in physics CIE.

books.title: Microelectronic Circuits: Theory and Applications
books.author: Adel S. Sedra, Kenneth C. Smith
books.subject: Analog Electronics & Circuit Analysis
books.description: Gold-standard textbook for BJT and MOSFET amplifier biasing, small-signal models, frequency response, differential amplifiers, and operational amplifiers.
books.currentOwnerNotes: Solid textbook with clear op-amp circuit diagrams. Excellent for analog design.
